conflicts.resolution: Meena rejected payments and Lakshmi agreed to defer it, deciding no online payments for version one and using WhatsApp instead.

dimensions.justification: Site exists to promote Velugu Cove tourism, homestays, seafood, and boat tours. Success measured by visitor numbers, WhatsApp enquiries, and bookings.
Target audience includes tourists from Hyderabad and Bangalore. Mobile usage highlighted. English required, Telugu desired.
Lakshmi needs rooms displayed and contact/booking. Ravi needs menu, timings, directions. Meena needs boat tours and safety info.
One single page site covering all businesses with sections for homestay, restaurant, boat tours, directions, and WhatsApp contact.
Features include WhatsApp buttons with pre-filled messages, menu/timings display, tour details, directions, and photo gallery.
Testable criteria provided for the WhatsApp button feature, but other requirements lack Given/When/Then criteria.
Each business owner supplies their own text and photos. Lakshmi coordinates collection. Developer optimizes photos.
Visually appealing requested with beautiful sunset photos, but no specific style, color palette, or reference sites given.
Mobile-friendly requirement stated explicitly. Basic SEO and accessibility are not detailed.
Budget is $400 ($40,000 cents). Deadline is before the season starts next month (5 days delivery). Online payments explicitly out of scope.

acceptance_criteria: Given a visitor clicks the WhatsApp button, When the chat opens, Then it opens a WhatsApp chat with the relevant business phone number and a pre-filled greeting message.
